entries.label: Hit Points
entries.detail:
Fighter: 10 hit points at level 1, then each level adds a d10 roll (or the fixed value 6) plus your Constitution modifier (+1).
• Level 1: 10 + 1 = 11
• Level 2: entered 7 + 1 = 8
• Level 3: fixed value 6 + 1 = 7

entries.label: Fighting Style
entries.detail: While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class. — You have honed your martial prowess and gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice (see "Feats"). Defense is recommended. Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace the feat you chose with a different Fighting Style feat.

entries.label: Second Wind
entries.detail: You have a limited well of physical and mental stamina that you can draw on. As a Bonus Action, you can use it to regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level. You can use this feature twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. When you reach certain Fighter levels, you gain more uses of this feature, as shown in the Second Wind column of the Fighter Features table.

entries.label: Weapon Mastery
entries.detail: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice weapon drills and change one of those weapon choices. When you reach certain Fighter levels, you gain the ability to use the mastery properties of more kinds of weapons, as shown in the Weapon Mastery column of the Fighter Features table.

entries.label: Action Surge
entries.detail: You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action, except the Magic action. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. Starting at level 17, you can use it twice before a rest but only once on a turn.

entries.label: Tactical Mind
entries.detail: You have a mind for tactics on and off the battlefield. When you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of your Second Wind to push yourself toward success. Rather than regaining Hit Points, you roll 1d10 and add the number rolled to the ability check, potentially turning it into a success. If the check still fails, this use of Second Wind isn't expended.

entries.label: Improved Critical
entries.detail: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

entries.label: Remarkable Athlete
entries.detail: Thanks to your athleticism, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks. In addition, immediately after you score a Critical Hit, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

entries.label: Resourceful
entries.detail: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

entries.label: Skillful
entries.detail: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

entries.label: Versatile
entries.detail: You gain an Origin feat of your choice (see "Feats"). Skilled is recommended.

entries.label: Savage Attacker
entries.detail: You've trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

entries.label: Alert
entries.detail: Initiative Proficiency. When you roll Initiative, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll. Initiative Swap. Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the Incapacitated condition.
